text_block_list.text: —Fuji Kiseki.

A peer of Marvelous Sunday who already 
radiates an overwhelming star quality.

A demeanor that captivates everyone's 
eyes. Brilliant acceleration. A 
mesmerizing run.

The one destined to stand at the pinnacle 
of the new era, a Triple Crown Umamusume 
in the making—
...'Used to be.'
"Fuji Kiseki Sidelined by Injury"

That shocking news spread through the 
world in an instant.

"Return date undecided; Classic 
participation looking hopeless." "Could 
this lead to retirement as is?"—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"...In truth, I must say the situation is 
extremely dire."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The injury Fuji Kiseki-san suffered is one 
that has forced countless Umamusume into 
retirement over the years.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"At minimum, recovery will take over a 
year. Even after that, whether a return to 
racing is possible..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… No way…… That can't be true……! To 
think I'll never get to see Lady Fuji 
Kiseki run again……!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
...You shouldn't cry so much. Fuji-sama 
acted so brave during the press conference 
the other day, didn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
So... w-we can't just... keep crying like 
this, either...! *sob*...!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, Fuji Kiseki is such a 
tragedy... Right after Brian, people were 
saying we might get a Triple Crown 
Umamusume two years running!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Over a year... is pretty long. If you take 
that long of a break, even if the injury 
heals, there's no guarantee you'll ever 
run like you used to...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Totally... But seriously, she's probably 
the one having the hardest time with all 
that...

Unable to run for at least a year. No 
guarantee of a full recovery. No prospect 
of running like before—

Because she shone so blindingly bright as 
a star, the shadow she cast wrapped the 
world in deep, dark obscurity...

And then one day, during training hours. 
Heading to the track as usual—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, today too, huh... There's quite a few, 
kids who've started taking days off 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpai was super popular, after all. 
It must be such a shock for all the girls 
she inspired, and the ones working hard 
hoping to run alongside her...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"My heart hasn't really been in it lately 
either, I guess... *sigh*."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And so, you see. My marvelous, Fuji's 
marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If rivals who've made different kinds of 
effort run in the same race one day... ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What kind of marvelous is waiting there?! 
Isn't your heart pounding? Aren't you 
excited?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Using that thrilling excitement as fuel! 
Don't you think it helps you give it your 
all?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!! I talked to that girl just 
now, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it☆ Someday, I'm 
gonna have a marvelous race with Fuji★

A memory of Marvelous Sunday from that day 
suddenly crossed my mind.

Fuji Kiseki was... a beacon of hope for 
her, as well.
choice_data_list: (And to think it ended up like this...)

text_block_list.text: I gaze out at the deserted training track.

Her classmate's injury. The shock must be 
immense. It surely was a tragedy for her 
as well.
...But—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!! There's no reason to 
hang your head at all.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Stretching out right in front of us, 
forever and always, is a marvelously 
bright road☆

I hurried out to the track and got 
everything ready. Today's plan was to 
focus on training acceleration.

Sprint tubes, ankle weights... Don't 
forget the ice packs to cool down as 
needed and reduce strain on the body.

...I am certain it won't go to waste. 
Because Marvelous Sunday is...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Traineeeerrrr!!

Because I'd like to think I know better 
than anyone what kind of Umamusume she 
really is.

I admire things like that about you. 
...And that's precisely why I want to 
support you.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, come on, come on, come on☆ Let's 
get today's Marvelous training started★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek☆ As expected of you, Trainer★ That 
motivation is marve-louuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ...Say, Trainer, did you hear about Fuji?

"Even so," she continued. While looking as 
straight as possible into those 
ever-sparkling eyes of hers.

Train. Get stronger. Then run in a big 
race and share the Marvelous with 
everyone.

"What I must do has never changed. Because 
right now—"

Producing results in races while she 
struggles with injury and cannot run as 
she pleases is the best cheer they can 
send to Fuji Kiseki.

I won't change. I won't lose my way. I'll 
look forward. Making the world marvelous—
choice_data_list: I'll make Fuji Kiseki marvelous too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh~☆★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! That's it!! You're so right, 
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The current us☆ are super-duper Marvelous, 
aren't we★☆★

Marvelous Sunday dashes forward. With 
enough force to blow away even the heavy 
clouds cloaking the sky—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Marvelous—
